Lemma
[Second space derivatives of a convolution with $P_N$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0296, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0297 ↗ lem:chow-iii-parametrix-convolution-first-derivative 1. ch24:24.17\group Convolution Series

Under the hypotheses of Lemma 2, in a geodesic coordinate neighborhood containing the half-injectivity ball, $P_N*G$ is $C^2$ in $x$, and its second derivatives are obtained by differentiating $P_N$ twice under the convolution integral.
